early_stopping.rule: stop after 500 consecutive updates with no strictly smaller validation mean cross-entropy; restore the smallest observed value

split_rule: round 0.2 times each class count to nearest integer; split before fitting features
snapshot_selection: Epoch 10 is an early predefined checkpoint, epoch 57 is selected by validation loss, and epoch 10000 is the predefined final budget; all belong to one trajectory.
limitations: Validation data are used for checkpoint selection; no independent test set.
This is one illustrative trajectory, not a comparison across datasets or random seeds.
